---
title: "Model Results"
---

## Model comparison (AIC)

| Model | n | AIC | ΔAIC |
|---|---|---|---|
| M2: spatial + length | 4,040 | 9,683 | 542 |
| M3: + country + year | 4,040 | 9,141 | 0 |
| M4: + Fulton's K | 3,451 | 7,422 | 0 (vs M3k) |

M4 (delta-gamma, spatial random field on hurdle-1 only) is the selected model.

## Key findings

- **Predator size**: unimodal effect, peaks mid-size (~45–55 cm)
- **Body condition**: positive in both hurdle components (β₁ = 3.25, 95% CI [2.29, 4.20])
- **Spatial range**: 32 km (M4) — predation correlated at sub-basin scale
- **Temporal**: 2016 and 2021 significantly higher than 2014 baseline
- **Spatial pattern**: highest P(sprat) in Bornholm Basin and western Gotland Basin
